DRIFT / design decisions

From ground to movement.

01

Brief

Build a daily shoe that can move between a quiet desk, a long walk, and a city evening without relying on loud performance codes.

02

System

One low-profile silhouette, a stable tonal base, and controlled color blocks that make the material transitions legible.

03

CMF direction

Soft mesh, brushed suede, recycled textile, and a mineral rubber sole under diffuse daylight. Color follows touch and wear.

04

Production check

Screen colors are directional. Textile, pigment, rubber, light, and batch variation still need physical samples before production.

About this study

DRIFT / Field 01 is an original fictional design exercise created for ColorVerse. It is not a real footwear brand, client project, product claim, or item for sale. The product image is a synthetic design visualization and should not replace physical material or footwear prototypes.
